title.zh: 把任务交给 AI 后，要做什么？
title.en: What Do You Do After Asking AI?

brief.zh: 先说清要做什么、需要多少、交回什么，再拿清单和原任务对照。
brief.en: Name the job, the quantities, and the thing you want back. Then compare the list with the assignment.

concept.zh: 用目标、数量和输出要求说明任务。
concept.en: Describe a task with a goal, quantities, and an output.

title.zh: 给 AI 一个能照着做的任务
title.en: Give the AI a task it can follow

body.zh: “准备画图用品”只说了方向。加上记号笔和纸张的数量，AI 就知道要准备什么。
body.en: “Get drawing supplies” gives a direction. Naming the markers and sheets of paper with their counts tells the AI what to prepare.

body.zh: 请 AI 交回一份清单，每样物品列一行。拿到清单后，就能按物品和数量逐项核对。
body.en: Ask for a checklist with one item per line. Then you can check each item and its quantity against the task.

prompt.zh: 制图队需要 2 支记号笔和 4 张纸。你要一份方便核对的清单，应该怎么问？
prompt.en: The mapping team needs 2 markers and 4 sheets of paper. How would you ask for a checklist that's easy to verify?

options.zh: 帮忙准备一些制图用品。
准备 2 支记号笔和 4 张纸，每样物品列一行清单。
options.en: Prepare 2 markers and 4 sheets of paper. Return a checklist with one item per line.

options.zh: 请尽快给制图队一份清单。
options.en: Please get the mapping team a checklist quickly.

feedback.zh: 物品和数量都确定了，每样列一行也方便逐项核对。
feedback.en: The items and counts are clear, and one item per line makes the list easy to check.

caption.zh: 给 AI 一张画图用品工单。物品和数量都还空着。
caption.en: The drawing kit ticket has empty spaces for the items and counts.

caption.zh: 在工单上写两支记号笔、四张纸。
caption.en: The ticket now specifies two markers and four sheets of paper.

caption.zh: 请 AI 逐项列清单，再和工单核对。
caption.en: Ask for an itemized checklist and compare it to the ticket.
